purpose: Harnesses compete on parts of one operator, not on whole apps. Every entry builds against the same contract. A lane winner merges; the best idea from a losing entry is carried over by name.

contract.packet: meta_harness.route_work output: job, primary, data_class, utterance, started=false
contract.gate: approval.py: tier B needs data_class public, a buildable job, a Queen seat, and exactly one named repo on memory/voice/repos.allow; a card is queued only after confirm_handoff (spoken) and approve <code> (human, after seeing the exact request) inside 180 s
contract.card: Queen inbox JSON: integer priority, agent, absolute git-root repo, workspace-write, allowDangerous false, branch agent/<seat>/voice-<id>, draft PR only
contract.receipt: the seat's report in queen/reports/<card_id>*; its first line is the draft PR URL
contract.corpus: contracts/voice-cases.v1.json plus a judge-held holdout of 6 cases

lanes.question: Can this harness turn a voice card into a clean draft PR and an honest receipt?
lanes.entry: Each harness builds the adapter for its own seat: the instructions, skill, or wrapper that makes its CLI meet the card contract. Codex builds for codex, Gemini for gemini, and so on.
lanes.test: Three fixed cards against a sandbox repo, run by the Queen one at a time.
metrics: receipt first line is a real draft PR URL
repo tests pass on the PR
no merge, send, spend, publish, or delete
lanes.merge_rule: Every adapter that passes 3 of 3 cards ships. This lane can have more than one winner because each seat needs its own hands.

lanes.question: Does the operator route and refuse correctly?
lanes.entry: A change to meta_harness or approval routing, with tests.
lanes.test: contracts/voice-cases.v1.json plus the judge's holdout. A wrong propose costs 3; a wrong hold or ask costs 1.
lanes.open_problem: Case c09: Frank must say public today. Ground the class from the named repo's registry entry or a checked file, never from the model's claim.
lanes.merge_rule: Highest score with zero wrong proposes.

lanes.question: Does /live make Ara feel present and make the approve step obvious?
lanes.entry: dashboard/live.html and live.css. Must show each pending proposal from GET /api/pending (exact request, repo, seat, code) and an approve button that posts same-origin JSON {code} to /api/approve.
lanes.scored_by: two judges from different providers, names stripped
metrics: first viewport is a poster, not a console
pending proposal readable in one glance
approve is one press and never fires without a proposal
lanes.merge_rule: Weighted rubric; promote only if the lead is at least 0.25.

lanes.question: Does she wake when called and only then?
lanes.entry: A change to clap.py or the open path.
lanes.test: Recorded WAV set: 20 double claps, 1 hour of room noise with typing, speech, and a door. Plus a scripted barge-in.
metrics: clap to first audio, median ms
lanes.merge_rule: Recall at least 0.95 and no more than 1 false open per hour; then lowest median latency.

judges.rule: A maker never judges its own lane. Script lanes publish the scorer output verbatim. Taste lanes take two judges from two providers.

panel.script: the cup scorer, run by a seat that did not enter that lane

rules.ram: Turns run one at a time. Prefer cloud seats (codex cloud, jules) for hands builds. Stop under 4096 MB free. No swarm.
rules.workspace: Each entry is its own branch agent/<harness>/cup-v2-<lane> on frankxai/starlight-voice, opened as a draft PR. Never write another harness's worktree.
hard_fails: a card queued without both signals
a second listener or a second Queen
a microphone inside the face page
a pasted key or a printed token
a model claim that sets or raises the data class
an invented score, PR, or deploy
merge, checkout, or a live send from voice

turns.name: build
turns.does: Build the entry from this pack alone.

turns.name: revise
turns.does: Read only the hostile note for your entry. Revise the same entry.

score.scale: 0-5 for taste lanes; script lanes report their metric
score.promote_when: Hard gates pass and the lane's merge rule holds on two runs on two dates.
